items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Dizzy and Charlie Parker had got their thing going... [INTERVIEWEE] That was another change.

ctx.x: It isn't the same at all. But, nevertheless, I think that -- you know -- you might say that Charlie Parker was in Jay McShann's band. And, it didn't mean -- so everybody always --
when you'd talk of Joy McShann -- what they'd think of immediately is Charlie Parker. But Joy McShann's band is going to be the same with or without Charlie Parker.
